source_snapshot.items: FIO 70% write/30% read QD1 512B one job
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes destructive 70/30 mix without resolving read-only source.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Critical safeguards, corrected randrw+rwmixread=30 and thresholds required.

old_problem: Named 70% write/30% read coverage conflicts with pure randread; destructive target/extent, duration authorization and measurable limits are absent.
disposition_reason: ED-04 defines destructive-storage safeguards but does not permit converting read-only `rw=randread` into a 70%-write job. That change creates major data-loss exposure and different coverage; source-owner authority and project thresholds remain indispensable.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row4 all18 XLSX cells and history2620.
Preserved the distinct 70%-write/30%-read ratio, QD1, 512B and one-job identity.
Did not select a target or run fio.

test_case.test_name: FIO QD1 512B 70% write/30% read SSD validation pending workload authority
test_case.purpose: Measure read/write IOPS, bandwidth and latency for the authorized write-heavy 70/30 random workload on a disposable SSD.
required_package: Source-owner approval of randrw+rwmixread=30 instead of randread
Exact disposable non-OS target, serial/topology, bounded extent and raw/filesystem mode
Authorized duration and approved per-direction/latency thresholds
Explicit data-loss approval, health abort policy and owner recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the source job. Once the 70%-write semantic is approved, prove the designated target is disposable and not OS/boot/mounted/in RAID/in use, capture identity and health, run the bounded QD1 512B one-job job once, preserve fio JSON and device telemetry, and leave storage recreation/remount to the owner.
test_case.expected_result: The approved 70%-write workload runs only on the authorized device, meets all approved metrics and leaves media/platform health unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved 70/30 semantics, exact target and numeric limits. A randread result has zero write coverage and cannot pass this case.
safety_gate: Block until source owner authorizes the write-heavy correction and data loss.
Reject OS, boot, mounted, RAID-member or open-holder targets.
Constrain filename/size/time and verify serial immediately before launch.
Abort on media/SMART/thermal/power errors; do not retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Threshold comparison and owner recovery disposition
test_case.recovery: If the selected namespace no longer matches the approved serial or media errors rise during this write-heavy profile, stop fio, preserve per-direction and health evidence, keep the volume offline, and return it to the storage owner for data-impact assessment and explicit reinitialization.

source_conflict.reason: 70%-write/30%-read title remains incompatible with read-only randread.
